item.buildtools.selection_staff.tooltip: Left-click block: set first point. Right-click block: set second point. Sneak right-click: open mode menu.
item.buildtools.advanced_selection_staff: Right-click places a point. Left-click removes a point. Sneak left-click places adjacent to the clicked face. Sneak right-click opens selection, measurement, and point tools.
item.buildtools.builder_wand.tooltip: Right-click previews/builds with the selected material. Middle-click a block to select it from inventory/storage. Use the Build Materials key or menu to browse materials. Left-click block opens builder menu.
item.buildtools.advanced_builder_wand.to: Right-click previews/builds with selected materials, gradients, random patterns, and plans. Middle-click a block to select it. Use the Build Materials key or menu to browse/order materials. Left-click block opens builder menu.
item.buildtools.builder_brush.tooltip: Right-click previews/applies brush edits. Sneak right-click picks replace target. Middle-click selects material from inventory/storage. Use the Build Materials key or menu to browse materials. Left-click block opens brush menu.
item.buildtools.area_breaker.tooltip: Right-click previews/removes the selected area. With an Undo or Redo Token, drops are stored in history.
item.buildtools.blueprint_trowel.tooltip: Right-click previews/pastes blueprints. Sneak right-click copies the current selection. Left-click block opens copy/paste controls.
item.buildtools.undo_token.tooltip: Right-click to undo your most recent operation. Left-click block opens undo menu.
item.buildtools.redo_token.tooltip: Right-click to redo your most recently undone operation. Left-click block opens redo menu.
item.buildtools.magnet.tooltip: While enabled in your inventory, nearby dropped items go straight into your inventory. Right-click to toggle.
item.buildtools.storage_link.tooltip: Reusable tool for linking storage blocks. Use it in the air to manage linked storage. Use it on linked storage to unlink. Limit: 10.
buildtools.area_breaker_preset.clear_sno: Only clears snow, crops, plants, vines, leaves, and fragile clutter.
buildtools.mode.fill.description: Places only in air or replaceable blocks.
buildtools.mode.replace.description: Places only in air touching the picked replace target block.
buildtools.mode.surface.description: Places only in air touching any solid block.

buildtools.rotation_mode.face_away_cente: Rotates supported blocks away from the selection center.
buildtools.rotation_mode.follow_path.des: Rotates supported blocks along the nearest advanced point segment.

buildtools.measure.dimensions.descriptio: Shows width, height, depth, box volume, and selected block count.
buildtools.measure.selection_count.descr: Shows generated selected blocks, air blocks, and solid blocks.
buildtools.measure.point_distance.descri: Measures delta and distance from advanced point #1 to #2.
buildtools.measure.path_length.descripti: Measures the ordered path through all advanced points.
buildtools.measure.bounds.description: Shows minimum and maximum generated selection coordinates.
buildtools.measure.center_lines.descript: Shows the center and half spans of the selection bounds.
buildtools.brush.paint.description: Paints the brush area with the selected material.
buildtools.brush.erase.description: Clears non-air blocks in the brush area.
buildtools.brush.replace.description: Replaces only blocks matching the picked target.
buildtools.brush.smooth.description: Levels nearby terrain toward the average height.
buildtools.brush.scatter.description: Randomly places selected blocks using density.
buildtools.brush.overlay.description: Places blocks on exposed top faces.
buildtools.brush.blend.description: Mixes selected materials with noise and falloff.
buildtools.menu.title: BuildTools Modes
buildtools.menu.materials.description: Updates outline and actionbar material counts.
buildtools.menu.material_selection.descr: Opens blocks available in your inventory and linked storage. Click up to 15 materials, click again to remove.
buildtools.menu.material_weight_help: Scroll to change weight. Shift-scroll changes by 10.
buildtools.menu.material_remove_help: Left-click to remove from the palette.
buildtools.menu.material_add_help: Left-click to add to the palette.
buildtools.menu.material_make_primary: Right-click to make primary without clearing the palette.
buildtools.menu.save_preset.description: Stores this selection size and shape as your favorite preset.
buildtools.menu.load_preset.description: Loads your saved preset at your feet.
buildtools.menu.save_plan.description: Stores the current wand result as a ghost plan without spending blocks.
buildtools.menu.build_plan.description: Builds your saved plan and charges materials.
buildtools.menu.brush_mode.description: Selects how the brush affects blocks.
buildtools.menu.brush_radius.description: Scroll while hovering to adjust brush radius.
buildtools.menu.brush_depth.description: Scroll while hovering to adjust brush depth.
buildtools.menu.brush_density.descriptio: Scroll while hovering to adjust brush density.
buildtools.menu.road_width.description: Scroll while hovering to adjust road width.
buildtools.menu.arch.description: Left-click selected arch to cycle mode. Right-click to rotate direction. Scroll to move peak. Peak: %s%%.
buildtools.menu.shape_hollow.description: Click while selected to toggle solid or hollow generation.
buildtools.menu.structure_shape.descript: Click while selected to toggle plain or detailed structure generation.
buildtools.menu.roof_shape.description: Click selected roof to toggle detail. Right-click to cycle ridge direction.
buildtools.menu.bridge.description: Path deck from advanced points. Detailed adds rails and underside supports. Click selected bridge to toggle detail. Scroll to adjust width. Width: %s.
buildtools.menu.tower.description: Hollow round tower shell. Detailed adds floors every %s blocks plus top battlements. Click selected tower to toggle detail. Scroll to adjust floor height.
buildtools.menu.curve.description: Smooth open 3D path through ordered points. Two points form a line. Peak: %s%%. Lower values turn toward the next point sooner; higher values hold the incoming direction longer.
buildtools.menu.gradient.description: Click to toggle gradient fill. Scroll to cycle direction.
buildtools.menu.gradient_direction.descr: Cycles gradient direction between X, Y, Z, and point order.
buildtools.menu.block_rotation.descripti: Cycles how rotatable blocks face when placed. Scroll while hovering to cycle.
buildtools.menu.advanced_shapes.descript: Opens advanced structure and path shapes with their augmentation controls.
buildtools.menu.advanced_shape.option.de: Left-click to increase or cycle forward. Right-click to decrease or cycle backward. Scroll while hovering to adjust.
buildtools.menu.custom_shape_mode.descri: Cycles how ordered advanced points drive smart shape generation.
buildtools.menu.insert_measurement_point: Adds the current measured point to the advanced point list. Midpoint measurement required.
buildtools.menu.stair_direction.descript: Cycles stairs between point order and a fixed horizontal direction.
buildtools.menu.random_pattern.descripti: Uses selected materials as a deterministic random pattern.
buildtools.menu.clear_selection.descript: Clears the current selection and preview.
buildtools.menu.selection_visibility.des: Toggles whether other players can see this selection.
buildtools.menu.copy_blueprint.descripti: Copies the current selection into the trowel clipboard relative to where you stand.
buildtools.menu.blueprint_create.descrip: Copies the current selection and opens a saved-blueprint name dialog.
buildtools.menu.blueprint_delete_mode.de: Select a blueprint, then click it again to confirm deletion.
buildtools.menu.back.description: Returns to the previous tool menu.
buildtools.menu.paste_blueprint_here.des: Previews the copied blueprint with Pos 1 at your feet.
buildtools.menu.paste_blueprint_selectio: Previews the copied blueprint at the current selection's first point.
buildtools.menu.confirm_paste.descriptio: Builds the currently previewed blueprint paste.
buildtools.menu.cancel_paste.description: Clears the current blueprint paste preview.
buildtools.menu.undo.description: Undoes the most recent BuildTools operation.
buildtools.menu.redo.description: Redoes the most recently undone BuildTools operation.
buildtools.menu.nudge.description: Moves the whole selection one block.
buildtools.menu.nudge_paste.description: Moves the current paste preview one block.
buildtools.menu.expand.description: Adds one block to this side of the selection.
buildtools.menu.shrink.description: Removes one block from this side of the selection.

buildtools.menu.rotate_selection.descrip: Rotates the selected area around Pos 1.
buildtools.menu.mirror_blueprint.descrip: Mirrors the copied blueprint before paste.

buildtools.menu.help.description: Opens concise BuildTools controls and workflow help.
buildtools.help.selection.lines: Basic: left/right-click set points. Advanced: right-click adds and left-click removes points. Use the menu for shapes, measurements, nudging, sharing, and presets.
buildtools.help.builder.lines: Middle-click selects a material. Right-click once previews and again confirms. The material browser supports search, palettes, weights, and linked storage.
buildtools.help.brush.lines: Right-click previews/applies. Sneak right-click picks a replace target. Use shortcuts, scrolling, or the menu for radius, depth, density, and mode.
buildtools.help.breaker.lines: Preview selected removals before applying. Stored drops use undo/redo history.
buildtools.help.blueprints.lines: Sneak right-click copies. Normal right-click previews and confirms. The library supports search, categories, sorting, renaming, and transforms.
buildtools.help.history.lines: History tokens enable undo/redo and can store drops until collected.
buildtools.help.shortcuts.lines: Open Controls > Key Binds > BuildTools to configure unbound actions. The status overlay shows the keys currently bound for the held tool.
